text:
Anna (infra): quick q — PR #8421 touches telemetry/collector/* and infra/helm/values.yaml, who is the CODEOWNERS approver here?
Raj (runtime): looks like telemetry/* is owned by @marta per CODEOWNERS, but helm values are infra team. you can ping infra on the PR.
Marta (telemetry): I see the PR, thanks for the ping. Small questions: does the collector change affect metric names? if yes we need an eval.
Anna (infra): no metric name changes, just batching config + a tiny env var. Main worry is approval routing since codeowners lists both teams for top-level paths.
Theo (platform): fyi we recently added a codeowners glob for telemetry that overlaps with infra for helms. That might be why both are required. We should avoid double-blocking.
Raj (runtime): can we relax CODEOWNERS to only require one approver for cross-owned paths? maybe add a rule: if path matches telemetry/* and helm/* then allow either telemetry OR infra.
Marta (telemetry): we can approve this one; it's low-risk. @Anna please request my review and tag `@marta` explicitly in the PR description so approvals route faster.
Anna (infra): tagging Marta now. Also: is there an async unblock flow for urgent infra patches if owner is OOO?
Theo (platform): yes — use the `#eng-oncall` rota for emergency merges or add `maintainers: infra` label and a CI-Bot approval can bypass if tests green + oncall ack. We should doc this better.
CI-Bot: NOTE: merge-bypass requires 2 approvals OR an oncall ack in thread. Current PR has 1 approval.
Anna (infra): ok adding oncall ack, @marta can you add your approval when you have sec? I also added a short PR checklist in the description.
Marta (telemetry): approved. left one minor nits comment about the env var default but not blocking. :thumbsup:
Raj (runtime): once CI finishes let's merge, but can we add a follow-up todo to split the overlapping CODEOWNERS rules? Theo — can you track that?
Theo (platform): will do, filing a short ticket to consolidate ownership globs and add an internal guideline for cross-team PRs.
Anna (infra): CI passed, merging now. Thanks everyone.
Raj (runtime): thanks — please verify staging telemetry after deploy.
Marta (telemetry): will check; ping me if anything looks off.
Anna (infra): merged. closing thread.
CI-Bot: merged PR #8421 into main (author: anna).
